purpose: Teach: 授与/保健所/延命/即答/一辺倒/疲弊/病名/早けれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学位授与の日、緊張するぞ
lines.en: Ren, you'll be nervous on degree-conferral day.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Not a question — a calm acknowledgment. Steady gaze. The weight of someone who has done this many times before. No warmth, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。保健所と共同研究を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently advancing collaborative research with the health department.
lines.style: Formal but genuine. Slight lift on each completed point, as if checking them off. A hint of pride barely below the surface. Respectful posture — he's speaking to someone he admires.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、延命研究にも携わってみろ
lines.en: You should try working on life-extension research too.
lines.style: Directive, but not harsh. A single firm tap on the suggestion — this is not optional, but it's offered as an opportunity. Brief pause after the statement, letting it land. Eyes still on him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授の即答に驚いております
lines.en: Yes. I'm startled by how quickly you arrived at that answer.
lines.style: Honest surprise held in check by politeness. A quiet intake of breath — he didn't expect such immediate clarity. Respectful but genuine. The surprise is real beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、一辺倒な研究法ではダメだ
lines.en: One-sided research methodology won't cut it, Ren.
lines.style: Firm correction, but not a reprimand. The directness of someone who sees a blind spot and names it plainly. No theatrics — just clarity. Pause on his name for weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室、メンバー全員が疲弊しないよう配慮します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the entire lab doesn't burn out in the process.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. He's understood the deeper point — this is about sustainability and care. Voice steady and committed. A note of maturity here, responsibility settling into him as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、病名のラテン語表記もマスターしろ
lines.en: And master the Latin nomenclature for diseases, Ren.
lines.style: Another layer added to the list. Not rushed — each directive lands with its own weight. Slight emphasis on 'Latin' — this matters. The tone says this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。早ければ来年度に博士を取得します
lines.en: Yes. With any luck, I'll have my doctorate by next fiscal year.
lines.style: Quiet determination with a thin thread of hope. The words land softly but with conviction. A small breath before the final phrase — he's allowing himself to believe it might happen. Formal register, but grounded.
